title: Independent sets in the fifth strong power of C_7 (Shannon capacity of the 7-cycle)
statement: Find as large an independent set as possible in C_7^5, the fifth strong power of the 7-cycle (two distinct 5-tuples over Z_7 are adjacent when every coordinate is equal or differs by 1 mod 7). An independent set of size a gives the Shannon capacity bound Theta(C_7) >= a^(1/5). The largest known has 367 vertices (Polak and Schrijver, 2018); a larger one improves it. Tao's page 9a lists better capacity bounds from much higher powers.
submission: Text file: the vertices, one per line, each as 5 digits 0-6 with nothing between them.
score: the size of the independent set (larger is better)

best_known.source: alpha(C_7^5) >= 367: Polak and Schrijver (2018), the row [PS2018] on Tao's optimization constants page 9a; read 8 Nov 2026
